description:
FILED s455e from s457ai ask 2 (kept conservative, unprobed, at the boxed-aggregates flip). perl: sub w { $_[0] .= "!" } my $obj = bless {k=>"v"}, "C"; w(@$obj{"k"}); -- probe whether the write reaches $obj->{k} (expected: yes, blessing does not change element aliasing). If perl aliases: widen %p-hash-elem-cell/p-gethash-argbox to treat a blessed hash like a plain one for ELEMENT aliasing (the :__class__ key itself must stay untouchable), with the elem-alias-01.t battery gaining blessed rows both gate settings. If perl does not: record the probe in this task and keep the guard. BAR: ~6 probes vs perl (blessed hash + blessed array twins, foreach values over a blessed hash, \$$obj{k}), guards, targeted sweep. Same family: check %p-alias-helem fallback arm.

PROBE VERDICT (s458ak, perl 5.40.3): PERL ALIASES, as the task predicted -- every one of the eight probe rows writes through on a blessed container.  PCL diverged on two of them: `w(@$obj{"k"})` printed v where perl prints v!, and `for my $v (@$obj{'a','b'}) { $v .= "!" }` left both values untouched.  CAUSE: %p-alias-helem and p-gethash-argbox both refused a container carrying :__class__ and handed back a detached copy.  FIXED by deleting that refusal from both.  The class key needs NO guard to stay untouchable: :__class__ is a KEYWORD and every Perl-level key arrives through to-string, so no program can name it -- verified by the guard row (ref() and keys are unchanged after the aliasing writes).  The ARRAY twins never had the refusal (a blessed arrayref carries its class on the BOX, not in the vector), which is why @$ar[0] already aliased.  Guards: Pl/t/elem-alias-01.t gains E13 (4 aliasing spellings + the class/keys integrity row + a copy negative), 19 -> 21 rows, green under BOTH PCL_RAW_ELEMS settings.  TWO PRE-EXISTING SILENT-WRONGS FOUND BY THE SAME PROBE BATTERY AND FILED, both unrelated to blessing (they fail on plain hashrefs too): #860 (f($ref->{k}) is not an @_ alias) and #861 (\$$h{k} loses the backslash entirely).  Bar met: full sweep GATE clean TOTAL 18340 (+0).
subject: p-gethash-argbox refuses to alias a BLESSED hash (:__class__ guard) but perl DOES alias @$obj{...} through @_ -- probe first, then widen or bless the refusal
